\begin{thm}[Main]\label{t:main}
Let $K$ be a \emph{slice knot}. Then $\abs{\sigma(K)} = 0$ in $\Z$ % comment
and \[ \Homeo(S^3) \simeq O(4). \] See~\cite[Thm.~2]{Fr82} and Lemma~\ref{l:x}.
\end{thm}
\begin{conj*}
Every \textbf{fibered knot} is ``nice''---compare \cite{G}:
\begin{itemize}\item first $a$; \item second.\end{itemize}
\end{conj*}
